timeline.event: Ethereum "Ether sale" (42-day crowdsale) begins
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Template for token crowdsales; ERC-20-style tokens on Ethereum later copied the model

timeline.event: Ethereum mainnet launches (Frontier)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Start of the chain on which all the ERC-20 history happens

timeline.event: EtherDelta starts operating (start of the period the SEC later held it an unregistered exchange)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: First popular on-chain token order book; listed any ERC-20 without vetting (token-name XSS against EtherDelta users is cited by d-xo, date unverified)
timeline.notes: SEC order period: 2016-07-12 to 2017-12-15

timeline.event: SEC DAO Report: some ICO tokens may be securities
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Start of the US regulatory turn against ICOs; reduced US-facing issuance later

timeline.event: China bans ICOs; seven regulators demand refunds
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Removed a large ICO issuing/buying base; shifted ICOs offshore

timeline.event: ICO funding passes $4B in 2017 (WSJ headline, cited by Wikipedia); ICO boom peak late 2017
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Hypothesis: 2017 is the first mass-deployment year of ERC-20 tokens; our series starts Jan 2017 so the boom should be visible if the census is right
timeline.notes: 2017 totals differ by source: ~$3.8B (EY) to >$4B (WSJ)

timeline.event: Bitcoin record high about $20,035.90 (CoinMarketCap)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Cycle-1 top; hypothesis: ICO-token issuance peaks within weeks of it

timeline.event: Ether record high about $1,413.72 (CoinMarketCap)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: ETH price top; hypothesis: new-token deployments peak around Q1 2018, to be checked against W4 counts

timeline.event: ICOs raised about $6.3B in Q1 2018 (more than all of 2017, per CoinDesk)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Peak of ICO fundraising; hypothesis: Q1-Q2 2018 is the top of the early new-token series
timeline.notes: Finance Magnates reports >$5B for Q1 2018; estimates differ by tracker

timeline.event: FT: "ICO market collapses as cryptocurrency prices tumble"
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: ICO bust: new-token deployments fall through 2018-2019
timeline.notes: Date is the FT article date cited by Wikipedia

timeline.event: Uniswap V1 factory deployed (block 6627917)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Permissionless token-ETH pools: anyone can list any ERC-20 with one tx; the pre-condition for rug pulls/honeypots at scale
timeline.notes: On-chain creation timestamp 2018-11-02 05:37:22 UTC (Etherscan getcontractcreation)

timeline.event: SEC settles with EtherDelta founder: first action against an unregistered DEX
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Chilling effect on order-book DEXs; AMMs (Uniswap) become the venue

timeline.event: BNB tokens stuck in Uniswap v1 because BNB returns no bool on some methods (Uniswap tweet)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Early public example of weird-token behaviour hitting an AMM
timeline.notes: Date derived from tweet snowflake id; link is cited by d-xo/weird-erc20

timeline.event: "Black Thursday" crash; BTC falls from about $8,000 to a low in the $3,600-$4,700 range depending on venue
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: COVID liquidity crash; DeFi liquidation stress (Maker); precedes DeFi summer
timeline.notes: Sources disagree on low

timeline.event: imBTC (ERC-777) reentrancy drains Uniswap V1 imBTC pool; Lendf.me hit next day
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: ERC-777 hooks as an integration hazard
timeline.notes: Dates vary 18/19 April by outlet

timeline.event: BSC genesis block (block 0) timestamp
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Chain existed from April 2020 though the public ecosystem started Sept 2020; census must handle empty early months
timeline.notes: Cernera et al. give block 0 = 2020-04-20; public mainnet/ecosystem growth Sept 2020

timeline.event: Uniswap V2 factory deployed (block 10000835)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: ERC-20/ERC-20 pairs: any two tokens can be paired; token creators no longer need ETH liquidity; fee-on-transfer support added via router
timeline.notes: On-chain creation timestamp 2020-05-04 16:34:02 UTC; Xia et al. dataset starts 2020-05-05

timeline.event: Compound COMP distribution begins (liquidity mining)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Kicks off "yield farming"/DeFi summer and a wave of governance-token forks

timeline.event: Balancer pools drained (~$450-500k) via deflationary STA/STONK tokens
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Fee-on-transfer token + AMM invariant
timeline.notes: Exploit window 2020-06-28/29 UTC

timeline.event: Yearn YFI fair-launched (mid-July 2020)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: No-premine farm token; first of the "fair launch" copycats
timeline.notes: Exact day not verified; CoinMetrics/CoinDesk say mid-July

timeline.event: SHIB token contract deployed (block 10569013)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Dog-coin prototype; mania comes 15 months later
timeline.notes: On-chain creation timestamp 2020-07-31 18:32:43 UTC

timeline.event: YAM v1 rebase bug bricks governance; market cap collapses >90%
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Farm-fork wave and rebasing-token risk; many unaudited forks follow

timeline.event: SushiSwap factory deployed (vampire-attack fork of Uniswap)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Uniswap forks proliferate; copy-paste forks lower the cost of launching tokens + pools
timeline.notes: On-chain creation 2020-09-04 10:10:39 UTC; SUSHI token launched late Aug 2020

timeline.event: UNI governance token airdropped (September 2020)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Airdrop farming becomes a behaviour; set the template for later airdrops
timeline.notes: Month-level per source; exact day not verified

timeline.event: PancakeSwap launches on BSC (September 2020)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: BSC becomes the cheap-gas venue for token launches; the rug-pull and 1-day-token capital of 2021-22 (Cernera et al.)
timeline.notes: Month-level only

timeline.event: Uniswap V3 factory deployed; V3 released 2021-05-05
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Concentrated-liquidity pools; fee tiers; token listing flows unchanged but fragmented across pools
timeline.notes: On-chain 2021-05-04 19:27:00 UTC; release date 5 May 2021 from Wikipedia

timeline.event: London upgrade (EIP-1559)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Fee burn; changes gas dynamics for token deployment costs

timeline.event: Cream Finance loses ~$18.8M via AMP (ERC-777-like) reentrancy
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Second major hook-token reentrancy

timeline.event: Arbitrum One mainnet opens to the public
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Cheap L2 deployments; ecosystem takes off through 2022-2023
timeline.notes: Arbitrum Nitro regenesis (Aug 2022) resets block numbering; plan for this in census

timeline.event: SHIB all-time high (about $0.000086 on 2021-10-27/28); SHIB passes DOGE in market cap
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Dog-coin / "SHIB killer" clone wave (BSC and Ethereum), peak of the 2021 meme mania
timeline.notes: Peak price differs by provider; no source found for a "Robinhood petition"

timeline.event: SQUID (Squid Game token) honeypot/rug: ~$3.4M taken
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Canonical honeypot rug; later cited by Solidus as most prolific honeypot
timeline.notes: Chain is BSC per widely reported accounts; source above does not name chain

timeline.event: Bitcoin record about $68,789; ether record about $4,878 (Nov 2021)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Cycle-2 top; token-pool creation on Uniswap V2/V3 and PancakeSwap near peak into early 2022
timeline.notes: ETH ATH: https://cointelegraph.com/markets/ether-price-holders-all-time-high-hopes-fade-crypto-analysts (Nov 2021)

timeline.event: Optimism opens mainnet to everyone (December 2021)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Third major L2; OP launched Dec 2021; Bedrock regenesis June 2023
timeline.notes: Month-level only; verify exact day if used in a chart

timeline.event: Agave and Hundred Finance exploited on Gnosis Chain (~$11.7M) via ERC-677 hook reentrancy
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Hook tokens on bridged assets

timeline.event: Terra/UST collapse (May 2022); ~$60B wiped in days
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: 2022 bear market begins; fewer legitimate launches, scam share rises
timeline.notes: Month-level; exact day to verify

timeline.event: OFAC sanctions Tornado Cash; Circle blacklists USDC in sanctioned addresses
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Real-world use of token blocklists on a "decentralised" asset

timeline.event: The Merge (proof of stake)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: No direct effect on token deployment; attention shift to staking tokens (stETH rebasing)

timeline.event: FTX files for bankruptcy
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Cycle-2 bottom region; token launches and liquidity trough

timeline.event: Solidus: 117,629 scam tokens deployed Jan 1-Dec 1 2022 (350/day), up 41% on ~83,400 in 2021; 8% of ERC-20 and 12% of BEP-20 tokens alleged scams
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Closest industry comparator for our scam-share series (2021-2022)
timeline.notes: Publication date; methodology not public in the article

timeline.event: SafeMoon V2 public burn bug: ~$8.9M drained from SFM/BNB pool
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Reflection-token class; upgradeable token contract
timeline.notes: Reports say 28 or 29 March

timeline.event: Shapella upgrade (staking withdrawals)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Re-risking cycle begins in H2-ish 2023; liquid staking rebasing tokens mainstream

timeline.event: PEPE deployed and stealth-launched (block 17046105)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Start of the 2023 memecoin season; spawned thousands of "pepe-clone" tokens within weeks
timeline.notes: On-chain 2023-04-14 14:51:35 UTC; PEPE hit ~$1.6B market cap in late April-May 2023 (https://thenftbrief.substack.com/p/what-is-pepe-coin-a-profile)

timeline.event: Base opens to developers (mainnet, pre-public)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Solidus counted >500 scam tokens on Base between this date and the public launch

timeline.event: BALD rug pull on Base: liquidity removed (reported $25.6M, later estimates ~1,034 ETH ~$1.9M; deployer profit ~$5-6M)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: First headline Base rug; shows Base hosted scams before public launch
timeline.notes: Token launched 2023-07-29; dollar figures conflict between outlets

timeline.event: Base opens to the public; Onchain Summer begins
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Base DAU >100k within a day; low fees make launching tokens near-free

timeline.event: friend.tech launches on Base
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Drives Base transaction volume record
timeline.notes: Sources differ by a day or two

timeline.event: Dencun (EIP-4844 blobs) cuts L2 fees
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: L2 gas collapses: cheap token deployment on Base/Arbitrum/OP

timeline.event: Base memecoin season (BRETT, DEGEN, TOSHI); Base TVL doubles in March
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Base becomes the memecoin venue on EVM
timeline.notes: BRETT launched Feb 2024 (sources disagree on day)

timeline.event: Cointelegraph Magazine study: of 1,000 new Base tokens (Mar 19-25), 16.9% suspected malicious (honeypot/high tax), 90.8% fail at least one check
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Direct comparator for Base scam share in a single week
timeline.notes: Publication date; uses DEXTools auditors

timeline.event: Virtuals Protocol begins "Initial Agent Offerings" on Base (October 2024)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Per-agent ERC-20 tokens paired against VIRTUAL; AIXBT and "agent token" wave
timeline.notes: Month-level; VIRTUAL up 161% in the week to 2024-11-29

timeline.event: Clanker (Farcaster bot-deployed ERC-20 factory) starts on Base (November 2024)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: ~166k tokens in 4 months; makes token creation a chat command; huge volume of deployments
timeline.notes: Month-level; token counts from a secondary write-up

timeline.event: Official TRUMP memecoin launches (Solana)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Cross-chain attention spike; memecoin launchpad boom; EVM chains compete for flow
timeline.notes: Not an EVM chain; included as a driver. Sources say 17 or 18 Jan

timeline.event: Uniswap V4 PoolManager deployed; V4 released 2025-01-31
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Hooks enable launchpad-style pool factories (e.g., Flaunch); native ETH pools
timeline.notes: On-chain 2025-01-23 16:16:47 UTC; release date from Wikipedia

timeline.event: four.meme exploited (~$183k); BNB Chain meme launchpad
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: BNB Chain has pump-style bonding-curve launchpad; its tokens migrate to PancakeSwap
timeline.notes: Launch date of four.meme itself not verified (mid/late 2024)

timeline.event: SEC staff statement: meme coins generally not securities
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Lowers US enforcement risk for memecoin issuance; fraud still covered

timeline.event: ZORA token launched on Base (April 2025)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Zora turns posts into tradeable ERC-20 coins on Base
timeline.notes: Launch date from a secondary source

timeline.event: Pectra upgrade
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Account abstraction (EIP-7702) changes who can be an "EOA admin"; relevant to control classification

timeline.event: Zora creator coins exceed 50,000 new tokens in a day (vs ~6,500/day a month earlier)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Single launchpad can dominate monthly ERC-20 deployment counts on Base: counts need per-factory decomposition
timeline.notes: ForkLog 2025-07-30; Zora = 67.7% of all launches on Base+Solana combined that day

timeline.event: Ether record about $4,946
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: ETH cycle high
timeline.notes: Peak price varies $4,946-$4,954 by provider

timeline.event: Bitcoin record about $126,000 (Oct 6-7); Oct 10 crash with ~$19B liquidations
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Cycle-3 top and the largest liquidation event; BNB "meme szn" runs in Oct 2025
timeline.notes: Peak date Oct 6 vs 7 differs by source; BNB meme season: https://atomicwallet.io/academy/articles/top-5-bnb-chain-memecoins-october-2025-season

timeline.event: Fusaka upgrade
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: PeerDAS; L2 data costs fall further

timeline.event: Bitcoin falls to about $60,000 (February 2026); later low about $57,700-$58,500 in June 2026; ~50% drawdown
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: 2026 drawdown; expect lower launch activity on mainstream chains in H1 2026
timeline.notes: Low-quality sources; verify against a price-history provider before charting

timeline.event: Robinhood Chain opens to the public (EVM L2)
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Top-3 chain by transactions within 3 months; Pons launchpad; new rug-factory venue (not in our 6 chains)

timeline.event: Analyst Wazz links 53 Robinhood Chain launches (Jul 10-Sep 21) to one operation extracting >= $18.43M
timeline.why_it_matters_for_token_deployments: Current example of syndicated launchpad rugs
timeline.notes: Single-analyst finding
